featured_reviews.name: Rajesh
featured_reviews.review_text:
We stayed at Zenith Hospitality Apartments, Prabhadevi, from 15th to 19th December 2025 (4 nights). Our booking was managed by Mr. Bhushan.

Room tariff details:
- ₹4000 for single occupancy
- ₹4500 for double occupancy
- ₹5500 for triple occupancy (1 double bed + 1 mattress)

Rates Including Breakfast (They offered on 2nd day which we need to have in 9th floor) we didn’t had it since it’s not regular breakfast we have(from day 3 they stopped offering).

Key points:
- Pricing is fixed and non-negotiable. Offering a small discount of ₹500–₹1000 might help attract more guests.
- Kitchen usage costs ₹1000 extra.
- Washing machine usage is ₹150 per use (around 10 clothes).
- Wi-Fi connectivity was quite slow during our stay.

Room experience:
We stayed in Room No. 102 on the first floor. The room was clean, quiet, and very comfortable — perfect for a peaceful rest. We’d rate the comfort and ambience a full 5⭐.

Suggestion: After check-in, it’s good to personally inspect pillows and mattresses for hygiene.

Location:
The property is conveniently located about 500 meters from Siddhivinayak Mandir 🛕 and close to several restaurants, Reliance Digital, Subway, and wine shops — all within walking distance.
- Worli Metro Station: 2 km
- Siddhivinayak Metro Station: 1.3 km
- Dadar Station: ~5.5 km (₹10–₹15 by shared taxi / ₹50–₹200 by Rapido or auto depending on time)

Staff feedback:
On the last day, I requested a few hours of late checkout. Mr. John from operations was very polite and cooperative — truly customer-oriented.
- John (Operations): Helpful and courteous.
- Bhushan (Partner): Professional and follows the policies strictly.
- Ravi (Caretaker): Only follows orders and ensures payments are cleared timely.

Overall, it was a pleasant and peaceful stay. The property is well-located, rooms are comfortable, and staff are supportive. A few improvements in pricing flexibility, Wi-Fi 🛜 quality, and consistent breakfast service would make the experience even better.
